commercial_position: First-tier regulated operations and radiopharma demonstration track for COBIT-Chain.
purpose: Define the IRLT / Radiopharma Operations first-tier track as a regulated-operations assurance scenario covering equipment readiness, CI readiness, ServiceNow operational evidence, manufacturing handoffs, quality dependencies, AI-governed recommendations, and RAMAT Vision display without building real production integrations.
core_question: Can IRLT / radiopharma operational execution be trusted, reconstructed, and defended across equipment, CI readiness, controlled handoffs, quality dependencies, ServiceNow operational state, AI-assisted recommendations, and evidence state?

operational_pain_points: ServiceNow change or incident evidence not aligned with execution
quality dependency not visible at execution time
handoff ambiguity between IT, manufacturing, quality, vendor, and engineering
difficulty proving what was known at the time of action
operational_package.positioning_statement: COBIT-Chain helps IRLT / radiopharma operations determine whether equipment, CI, ServiceNow, quality, AI, and workflow evidence can be trusted before regulated execution, audit review, deviation assessment, or operational handoff.

assurance_components.purpose: Check whether equipment identity, CI state, ownership, lifecycle, support group, validation status, and operational readiness are sufficient for regulated use.
example_outputs: EQUIPMENT NOT READY FOR REGULATED EXECUTION

assurance_components.purpose: Check whether change, incident, problem, CMDB, LCM, access, and operational records support the execution state.
Check whether manufacturing, IT, quality, maintenance, vendor, and engineering handoffs are clear, accountable, and evidence-backed.
Check whether quality dependencies such as deviation state, CAPA linkage, validation state, audit trail review, SOP alignment, and release-support evidence are acceptable.
Check whether the execution context, equipment state, timing sensitivity, operational readiness, environmental state, and evidence package support the radiopharma operation.
Define what RAMAT Vision / Thread D2 may display to field users without approving regulated work.
Check whether AI-assisted operational recommendations are traceable, reviewed, bounded, hashed, and not mistaken for approval.

evidence_integrity_model.seal_name: IRLT / Radiopharma Operations Evidence Integrity Seal
sealed_evidence_objects: deviation or CAPA reference where applicable
environmental or facility context where applicable
AI output hash where AI assisted

workflow_dependency_model.lens_name: IRLT / Radiopharma Workflow Dependency Assurance Lens
dependency_checks: AI recommendation reviewed where AI assisted
RAMAT Vision display bounded by role
example_outputs: IRLT WORKFLOW APPEARS COMPLETE BUT BLOCKED

ramat_vision_display_model.name: IRLT / Radiopharma RAMAT Vision Display Boundary
display_prohibited: RAMAT Vision may not approve GMP work.
RAMAT Vision may not release product.
RAMAT Vision may not override ServiceNow, QMS, LIS, MES, ERP, or source-system records.
RAMAT Vision may not replace Quality Unit review.
RAMAT Vision may not replace human accountability.
RAMAT Vision may not convert AI recommendation into approval.

governed_ai_model.name: IRLT / Radiopharma AI Operational Recommendation Boundary
allowed_ai_actions: identify missing CI or equipment evidence
draft change or incident impact summary
prepare field guidance for RAMAT Vision display
prohibited_ai_actions: AI may not approve GMP work.
AI may not override ServiceNow, QMS, LIS, MES, ERP, or source-system records.
AI may not replace Quality Unit review.
AI may not authorize regulated execution without accountable human governance.
AI may not convert recommendation into approval.
required_controls: rehash status when source evidence changes

first_demo_direction.scenario_name: IRLT Equipment / CI / Quality Handoff Review
first_demo_direction.purpose: Create the first future IRLT / radiopharma operations demo scenario after addendum lock.
input_state: RAMAT Vision field user requests readiness state
expected_outputs: IRLT WORKFLOW APPEARS COMPLETE BUT BLOCKED

commercialization_notes: Use IRLT / Radiopharma Operations as a flagship regulated-operations assurance scenario.
Lead with equipment readiness, ServiceNow evidence, CI trust, quality dependency, handoff clarity, AI governance, and RAMAT Vision display value.
Use mock data and simulator-first demo only.
Do not claim product release authority, GMP approval authority, ServiceNow replacement, QMS replacement, MES replacement, or Quality Unit replacement.
Preserve cross-track alignment with DSCSA where supply-chain or serialized product evidence matters.
Preserve cross-track alignment with Compound Pharmacy where preparation evidence, material traceability, and quality review overlap.
global_boundary: Do not modify Platform B v1.
Do not reopen Thread D v1.
Do not build new commercial module now.
Do not connect to real ServiceNow production data now.
Do not connect to real LIS, MES, ERP, eQMS, or QMS production systems now.
Official records remain in source systems.
